column1: # Generated for Gimbel & Associates AI Assessment Agent
# - 16 rows covering all combinations: 4 Operation Types × 4 Revenue Bands
# - Values represent industry averages for each segment
# - Hybrid Operations: Combination of multiple printing technologies
# - AvgLaborCostPct: Labor costs as % of revenue (lower is better
# - AvgMaterialWastePct: Material waste as % of total material costs (lower is better)
# - AvgOnTimeDeliveryPct: Jobs delivered on/before promised date (higher is better)
# - AvgGrossMarginPct: Gross profit margin % (higher is better)
# - AvgJobProfitabilityScore: Ability to track job-level profitability
# - AvgCustomerRetentionPct: Annual customer retention rate (higher is better)
# - AvgEmployeeTurnoverPct: Annual employee turnover rate (lower is better)
# - AvgSalesGrowthPct: Year-over-year revenue growth % (higher is better)
# - Larger companies typically show: lower labor costs %
# - Offset Print: Higher labor costs for small runs
